docs.title: Generating secrets
docs.text:
# APP_SECRET / REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET (32+ random bytes)
openssl rand -hex 32

# Strong DB passwords
openssl rand -base64 24

Never commit .env.local or .env.prod.local. Keep production secrets out of the committed .env file.

docs.title: JWT keys
docs.text:
The container entrypoint docker/app/entrypoint.sh manages the key pair:

  • If both keys already exist, they are reused as-is.
  • In non-prod environments missing keys are generated automatically into the standard paths (2048-bit RSA) and persist under the mounted ./var/jwt directory (var/jwt on the host). The private key is written with mode 600.
  • In prod (APP_ENV=prod) missing keys abort startup with an error — keys must be generated on the host first.

Generate production keys on the host before starting:

mkdir -p var/jwt
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048
openssl rsa -pubout -in var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -out var/jwt/jwt_public.pem
chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

If the private key has a passphrase, set JWT_PASSPHRASE in .env.prod.local.

docs.title: Building images
docs.text:
The Dockerfile targets a small final image (≈90 MB): php:8.4-fpm-alpine + extensions (pdo, pdo_mysql, intl, zip, opcache) + Composer. Dependencies are installed first (cached layer) with composer install --no-dev --no-scripts, then the app source is copied and --no-dev --optimize autoloader dumped. var/ is created and owned by www-data.

# Dev — build and start everything
docker compose up -d --build

# Explicit env file (custom ports / credentials / integrations)
cp .env.example .env.docker.local
docker compose --env-file .env.docker.local up -d --build

# Production
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build

Do not put production secrets in the committed .env file.

docs.title: First-run and migrations
docs.text:
Development (override applies automatically):

docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

Production:

docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

The migration chain is also validated by CI (.github/workflows/migrations.yml), which applies every migration from scratch against a fresh MySQL 8.4 and checks doctrine:migrations:status.

Useful migration commands:

docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status   # pending?
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate   # apply

docs.title: Health checks
docs.text: Both endpoints live in src/Core/Controller/HealthController.php and are public (outside the /api firewall) so orchestrators and load balancers can poll them without tokens.

docs.title: /health/live
docs.text: Liveness probe. Always answers 200 {"status":"ok"} while PHP can serve requests. Use this to detect a wedged process.

docs.title: /health/ready
docs.text:
Readiness probe. Responses:

// 200 — ready
{"status": "ok", "checks": {"database": "ok", "redis": "ok"}}
// 200 — ready, redis optional
{"status": "ok", "checks": {"database": "ok", "redis": "disabled"}}
// 503 — degraded
{"status": "degraded", "checks": {"database": "error", "redis": "ok"}}
  • database — SELECT 1 via the default Doctrine connection. Errors are logged, never echoed (avoids leaking driver details to anonymous callers).
  • redis — dependency-free TCP PING (RESP PING → +PONG). Reported disabled when OTP_REDIS_DSN is empty, otherwise ok / error.

The service is ready only when the database is ok and redis is ok or disabled. In the test environment the Redis probe is forced to disabled for deterministic CI results.

The nginx container healthcheck uses /health/ready through the full stack, so a green nginx container implies app + DB (+ optional Redis) are reachable.

docs.title: Scheduler commands
docs.text:
The scheduler service replaces a cron job. It loops forever, runs the commands below, then sleeps OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL (default 5 s):

Command Module Purpose app:trade:outbox:publish Trade Publish pending trade.order.created.v1 / trade.order.cancelled.v1 events to Messenger app:store:outbox:publish Store Publish pending store integration events app:inventory:outbox:publish Inventory Publish pending inventory integration events app:inventory:reservations:release-expired Inventory Release expired stock reservations app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due Settlement Re-queue allocation postings that are due for retry app:settlement:outbox:publish Settlement Publish pending settlement integration events

Each outbox publisher follows the same pattern (src/{Module}/Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php): markable rows are claimed with a lease (claim()), validated against known topics, dispatched onto the messageBus with a versioned envelope, then markPublished(); failures are deferred with an error message and retried later. The loop tolerates a crashed iteration (each run exits cleanly), making it safe to run as a scheduled job instead.

docs.title: Useful commands
docs.text:
Dev (production variants add -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local):

docker compose logs -f app                       # tail app logs
docker compose exec app php bin/console about    # run a Symfony command
docker compose exec app bash                     # shell into the app container
docker compose exec app php bin/console cache:clear
docker compose ps                                # service / health status
docker compose down                              # stop everything
docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build   # reset (WARNING: deletes all data)

docs.title: Verify after deploy
docs.text:
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/live
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/ready
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"identifier":"admin@example.com","password":"P@ssw0rd"}'

App: http://localhost:8080 — Swagger UI: http://localhost:8080/api/doc.

docs.title: Upgrading
docs.text:
Development:

git pull
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose exec app php bin/console cache:clear

Production:

git pull
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local up -d --build
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.prod.yaml --env-file .env.prod.local \
  exec app php bin/console cache:clear

docs.title: Custom nginx configuration
docs.text:
Replace docker/nginx/default.conf with your own config. Common changes:

  • Add TLS/SSL certificates and listen on 443
  • Change server_name to your domain
  • Add rate limiting or IP whitelisting

Then rebuild only nginx:

docker compose up -d --build nginx

The default config routes location / through index.php (front controller), forwards ^/index\.php(/|$) to app:9000 via FastCGI, internals the PHP location (never served directly), returns 404 for any other .php file, and caps client_max_body_size at 20m.

docs.title: 开发合同
docs.text: 保持模块化整体连贯的规则：层边界、跨模块 通信、服务边界、命名、代码风格、性能和安全性。 这些是面向开发人员的规范设计文档的配套文件 (docs/design/system-architecture.md、docs/design/system-contracts.md、 docs/design/module-design.md、docs/design/naming-convention.md)。

docs.title: 1. 图层规则
docs.text:
请求通过严格的单向链移动：

HTTP (Controllers / View mixins)  →  Service  →  Repository  →  Entity  →  Infrastructure
规则 来自 至 允许吗？ 为什么 R1 控制器 服务 是的 正常流量 R2 控制器 实体 是的 仅输入提示/返回 R3 控制器 存储库 不 浏览服务 R4 控制器 实体管理器 不 浏览服务 R5 服务 存储库 是的 数据访问 R6 服务 实体 是的 域名运营 R7 服务 实体管理器 是的 交易 R8 服务 其他服务 是的 DI，接口优先 R9 实体 存储库 不 实体是纯粹的 R10 实体 服务 不 没有业务逻辑部门 R11 实体 实体管理器 不 持久是外在的

docs.title: 交易合约
docs.text:
• 事务仅存在于 服务层 - 控制器从不调用 beginTransaction() / commit() / rollback() (T4)。
  • 相关实体的多个突变包含在 wrapInTransaction() (T1) 中。
  • 钱包转账使用实体的显式 beginTransaction/commit/rollback 锁定 (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) (T2)，并且 EntityManager 在经过一段时间后恢复 使用 $em->isOpen() 防护 (T3) 进行回滚。
  • Mixin 驱动的突变（createAction、batchUpdateAction）自动换行 除非@partial=true。 @partial=true 独立处理每一项；否则 所有项目一起提交或回滚。

docs.title: 抛出和捕获异常的地方
docs.text:
层 可能会抛出 必须抓住 实体 不 — 存储库 仅原则例外 — 服务 业务异常（InsufficientFundsException、OrderInvalidTransitionException、...） — 控制器 否 — 转换为 warning() 域例外 → warning() 为 400/404/500

/api/* 上未处理的异常通过以下方式转换为 JSON {code, message, class} ExceptionInterceptor（在开发中绕过）。

docs.title: 2. 跨模块通信
docs.text:
模块共享一个内核、一个 EntityManager、一个缓存和一个 Messenger 总线 — 但是 必须表现得就像它们是独立的服务一样。

关注 合同 教义协会 没有跨模块关联。 实体永远不会将另一个模块的实体作为关系/FK 耐用的参考资料 引用通过 UUID (App\Core\Utils\UUID) 或明确记录的业务密钥跨模块进行聚合 - 绝不是本地自动增量 ID 合同输入，标量数据输出 跨模块服务调用交换 仅标量/快照/DTO — 绝不是实体、存储库或 EntityManager 写 发件箱：发布模块将 *OutboxMessage 实体持久保存在同一事务中作为更改； app:{module}:outbox:publish 命令将其刷新到 Messenger 阅读 收件箱/消息处理程序：使用模块通过它们自己的 MessageHandler/ 处理程序读取另一个模块的状态，这些处理程序强制执行完整性和幂等性 直接存储库跨模块读取 禁止 依赖方向 业务模块可以自动装配 Core 和（接口优先）彼此； Core 绝不能导入业务模块；禁止循环模块依赖

docs.title: 信使路由（异步传输）
docs.text: 注册消息包括：交易订单创建/取消/商店接受/拒绝， 库存预留请求/确认/拒绝/释放，结算资金确认和 分配过帐。处理程序位于消费模块的 MessageHandler/ 中 目录（例如src/Store/MessageHandler/TradeOrderCreatedHandler.php， src/Inventory/MessageHandler）。失败传输是 failed 并重试 3 次， 加倍退避。

docs.title: 注册表用于横切扩展而不是直接连线
docs.text: 可热插拔的协作者通过标记的迭代器进行收集并通过 注册表 — 非硬连线：PaymentGatewayRegistry (payment.gateway)， PaymentAdjustmentRegistry、DepositProviderRegistry、WithdrawProviderRegistry、 MediaStorageRegistry、SettlementContextResolverRegistry 和 trade.price_calculator 定价链（优先排序，促销60）。

docs.title: 服务形态
docs.text:
• Every service implements a module interface: {Entity}ServiceInterface extends App\Core\Service\BaseServiceInterface.
  • Implementations extend App\Core\Service\BaseService, which composes BaseServiceInfrastructureTrait (container/EM/repository/logger/serializer, transaction wrapper, validators), BaseServiceReadListTrait (get/list, QueryBuilder listing, DQL compilation), and BaseServiceMutationTrait (new/update/remove, relation/date mapping, Serializer + Validator integration).
  • Services must not return raw HTTP responses (controller's job) and must not touch Request directly — use getCurrentRequest().

docs.title: Repository shape
docs.text:
• Repositories extend ServiceEntityRepository, take ManagerRegistry in the constructor, and return entities/arrays/scalars.
  • Repositories must not return raw QueryBuilder to consumers — that is the service layer's concern — and may expose a *RepositoryInterface when consumed by other modules.
  • Doctrine 3.6+ repositories carry the @extends ServiceEntityRepository<...> PHPDoc (enforced by Rector's AddAnnotationToRepositoryRector).

docs.title: Controller shape
docs.text:
• App controllers (public read) extend RestController with ApiView, DetailApiViewMixin, ListApiViewMixin; they set $serviceClass and may override commonFilter() for row-level scoping. No create/update/delete.
  • Manage controllers (admin CRUD) add Create/Update/DeleteApiViewMixin and are guarded #[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')] at class level.
  • Controllers declare only module-specific constructor dependencies — RequestStack, SerializerInterface, TranslatorInterface, container arrive via #[Required] setter injection on RestController.

docs.title: 4. Naming Conventions
docs.text:
The namespace carries the module; the class name carries the domain concept. docs/design/naming-convention.md is authoritative; the four rules are:

# Rule N1 Class name = domain concept (bare preferred); ownership lives in the namespace N2 Add a module prefix only on (a) cross-module collision/ambiguity, or (b) intra-module infrastructure (outbox / registry / gateway / provider) N3 Service / Controller / Repository / Event / Exception strictly mirror the entity name: {Entity}Service, {Entity}Controller, {Entity}Repository N4 Prefix policy is consistent within a module — never a mix of prefixed and bare

docs.title: Protected cross-module conflict groups (never drop the prefix)
docs.text:
Concept Reserved class names Order Trade\Order, Store\StoreOrder User Identity\User, Wechat\WechatUser OutboxMessage Trade\TradeOutboxMessage, Store\StoreOutboxMessage, Inventory\InventoryOutboxMessage ConsumedEvent Store\StoreConsumedEvent, Inventory\InventoryConsumedEvent

(The 2026-08-15 prefix refactor removed Wallet*/Inventory*/Store* prefixes for unique concepts — WalletTransaction→Transaction, InventoryStock→Stock, StoreMembership→Membership — with zero migration or API breakage; table names, URLs and route names were unchanged.)

Forbidden: inventing a service suffix (CategoryService for an entity Category is fine, but adding an arbitrary XxxService name for a non-service class is not), inconsistent prefixes inside a module, non-mirrored controller/service names.

docs.title: 5. Code Style
docs.text: Area Rule PHP >= 8.4, declare(strict_types=1) in new code Properties / returns Explicit types, never docblock-only; nullable as ?Type Namespace PSR-4 App\ under src/ Use statements Alphabetically ordered Files One class/trait/interface per file, filename = classname Classes PascalCase; methods/properties camelCase; constants UPPER_SNAKE Interfaces *Interface suffix; abstracts Abstract* / Base*; traits *Trait or descriptive (ListApiViewMixin) Tests *Test suffix, namespaced App\Tests\... Comments PHPDoc on interfaces/abstract methods; no comments on self-documenting code; @deprecated + migration notes for removals

docs.title: 6. Performance
docs.text: Practice Where it shows up Paginate every list RestController::pagination() — default limit 100, Doctrine Paginator for QueryBuilder Project columns instead of fetching everything @select, @display (e.g. reduce = id + __toString only) Push filtering to the database Expression DSL compiles to DQL (ExpressionDqlParser); the in-memory fallback is only a fallback Avoid implicit relation loading Relations load lazily; expand relation trees explicitly via @expands Concurrent writes are guarded Wallet uses optimistic locking (version column) and pessimistic writes for transfers; token rotation uses reuse detection Costly lookup is indexed/short UUID/IAM references on aggregates; repositories expose targeted queries Bulk admin writes stay transactional @partial=true for per-item mode, else single-transaction Long-running work goes async Messenger async transport + outbox publish commands

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
• JwtAuthenticator extracts and validates the Authorization: Bearer JWT and builds the Passport; TokenManager issues/revokes tokens and manages refresh-token lifecycle.
# Rule S1 Access tokens: RS256 signed, 7200s TTL S2 Refresh tokens: opaque, HMAC-SHA256-hashed in DB, 1-year TTL S3 Refresh tokens rotate on every use S4 Reuse of a revoked/replaced refresh token revokes ALL the user's tokens S5 Revoked access-token JTIs are blacklisted until natural expiry S6 Private keys are never committed S7 HTTPS in production

docs.title: Authorization
docs.text:
• Access control is centralized in config/packages/security.yaml: /api/v1/manage → ROLE_ADMIN; /api → IS_AUTHENTICATED_FULLY; the public list (auth flows, register, WeChat login, payment notify, docs, GET /api/v1/public) is PUBLIC_ACCESS.
  • Row-level scoping is per-controller via commonFilter()/listFilter() overrides (e.g. a user only ever sees their own records; the App-side filter enforces it). commonFilter() may return an array (['user' => $this->getUser()]), a QueryBuilder, or a server-owned DqlExpression such as new DqlExpression('entity.getUser() == this.getUser()') or new DqlExpression('entity.getStoreUuid() in storeUuids', ['storeUuids' => $allowed]). DqlExpression shares the @filter syntax (including in/not in with empty- collection safety) but is fail-closed and never uses the in-memory fallback. The designed Authorization bundle (docs/design/bundles/authorization.md) will build on this primitive for scoped RBAC, Store-scoped grants, field grants, and audit logging.
  • Manage controllers also carry class-level #[IsGranted('ROLE_ADMIN')].
  • Role hierarchy: ROLE_ADMIN: [ROLE_USER].

docs.title: Validation order
docs.text:
Controller field whitelist ($requiredCreateProperties / $acceptedCreateProperties)
  → controller hook validation (processCreateContent / processUpdateContent)
    → @transform expression
      → Service::update() → Symfony Validator → entity #[Assert\*] constraints

docs.title: Rate limiting
docs.text:
Resource Limit OTP request (per phone) 1 per 60s cooldown OTP verify (per phone) 5 attempts max

Backed by Redis (OTP_REDIS_DSN) or the local-cache fallback (LocalCacheOtpStorage).

docs.title: Logging hygiene
docs.text:
• Request bodies on PUT/POST are logged at INFO with user id, URI, body truncated to 1 KB.
  • Never log passwords, tokens, OTP codes in plaintext, or PII in production.
  • Channels: app, doctrine (dev), security.

docs.title: Money and identity
docs.text:
• Money is integer-cents or fixed-scale quantum (QuantumAmount, 18-decimal, brick/math) — never floats.
  • Aggregate references across modules are UUIDs — never raw FK or auto-increment ids.

docs.title: 8. Breaking-Change Policy
docs.text: Change Allowed? New mixin trait / hook with default impl Yes, documented Change a hook signature / remove a mixin method / change the response envelope NO — major version Add a query parameter Yes (backward compatible) Remove a supported query parameter NO — deprecation + major version Change BaseServiceInterface NO — cross-module impact assessment Add a module Yes, following the module checklist (docs/design/module-design.md)

docs.title: 9. See Also
docs.text:
• Development Workflow — branches, CI, static analysis gates
  • Testing — suites, helpers, the 90% coverage gate
  • API Contracts — envelope, auth, URL, pagination, webhooks
  • Architecture — practical overview of the module model and patterns
  • Normative contracts: docs/design/system-architecture.md, system-contracts.md, module-design.md, naming-convention.md, controller-design.md, per-module docs/design/bundles/*.md

docs.title: 开发工作流程
docs.text: 如何在 CI 中对该存储库进行分支、审查、分析和验证。按照这个 处理每一项更改，从单行修复到新模块。

docs.title: 1. 分支模型
docs.text:
该存储库使用基于主干的流程和长期集成分支：

main  ──────────────────────────────────────────────►  stable / release (PR target)
   \                                                /
    └── dev ───────────────────────────────►  integration (PR target for features)
           \
            ├── feat/xxx         feature branch (merged into dev)
            ├── fix/yyy          bug-fix branch (merged into main or dev)
            └── chore/zzz        tooling / docs / refactor branches
分公司 目的 CI 运行于 main 稳定的树干；只有经过审查、测试、迁移验证的代码才会出现在此处 推 + 拉请求 dev 发布前功能积累的集成分支 仅 pull_request (ci/migrations)，推送文档部署 feat/*、fix/*、chore/* 短期工作分支，每个 PR 一个 pull_request（定位 main/dev）

规则：

  • 切勿直接推送到 main 或 dev。 所有更改均通过拉取请求到达。
  • 针对 main（版本、修补程序）或 dev（功能、较大更改）打开 PR。
  • 经常变基或合并，使分支保持接近目标。
  • 较新的推送取代了对同一 PR 或分支的正在进行的检查（CI 已配置） 与 concurrency: cancel-in-progress: true）。

docs.title: 2. 编码标准
docs.text:
所有工具都需要 PHP 8.4+。

要求 标准 PHP版本 >= 8.4 (composer.json require.php) 命名空间 PSR-4 App\ 位于 src/ 下，App\Tests\ 位于 tests/ 下 标量/返回类型 尽可能明确；新代码中需要严格类型 (declare(strict_types=1)) 物业类型 显式（绝不仅限文档块） 可空 ?Type 语法 使用语句 按字母顺序排列 每个文件一个类 文件名等于类/特征/接口名称 评论 PHPDoc 仅针对接口和抽象方法；对自文档化代码没有评论 命名 参见naming convention——模块命名空间携带所有权，服务/控制器/存储库镜像实体名称

docs.title: 3.静态分析
docs.text: 静态分析的运行方式与 CI 的运行方式完全相同——在本地，它们必须在 PR 之前是绿色的。

docs.title: 3.1 PHPStan（8 级）
docs.text:
composer phpstan

在phpstan.neon中配置：

设置 价值 水平 8 路径 src/ 排除 src/*/Exception/*、src/Identity/Sms/AliyunSmsProvider.php 引导程序 vendor/autoload.php Symfony 集成 vendor/phpstan/phpstan-symfony/extension.neon（读作var/cache/dev/App_KernelDevDebugContainer.xml） 学说整合 vendor/phpstan/phpstan-doctrine/extension.neon 与 objectManagerLoader: phpstan-bootstrap.php PHPDoc 确定性 treatPhpDocTypesAsCertain: false（控制器使用特征混合中的$this->service/$this->get()） 通用物品箱 易微信AccessToken / Server合约

phpstan-bootstrap.php 启动一个最小的 App\Kernel 并返回 Doctrine EntityManager 因此 PHPStan 可以解析存储库/Doctrine 元数据。在 CI 中它运行 具有独立的 SQLite URL (var/phpstan.db)，因此它永远不会接触真正的数据库。

生成或刷新基线（仅当严格性要求强制时）：

composer phpstan-baseline

docs.title: 3.2 Rector（仅在 CI 中键入规则）
docs.text:
composer rector:types:check      # dry-run — the CI gate
composer rector:types            # actually apply the type rules

rector-types.php 在 src/ 上仅启用两个规则：

规则 它强制执行什么 AddAnnotationToRepositoryRector Doctrine 3.6+ 存储库必须携带 @extends ServiceEntityRepository<...> CompleteReturnDocblockFromToManyRector ->mappedBy/->inversedBy OneToMany/ManyToMany 返回 PHPDoc 集合

composer rector（更广泛的选择加入重构）不是 CI 的一部分 — 查看其差异 申请前请仔细：

composer rector      # dry-run of the broad rule set
composer rector:fix  # apply it

docs.title: 3.3 添加修复/基线条目
docs.text: 不要让 PHPStan 批发沉默。如果无法输入真正的边界情况，请添加 phpstan.neon 中的范围 ignoreErrors 条目 带有解释原因的注释 — 现有条目均带有解释（可选 SDK、特征混合、生命周期 回调）。

docs.title: 4. 提交约定
docs.text:
• 常规提交，仅英文。
  • 格式：type(scope): subject — 例如feat(settlement): add rule version diffing, fix(inventory): recover EM after rollback、test(wallet): cover concurrent transfers。
类型 用于 feat 新能力 fix 错误修正 refactor 行为保留重组 test 仅测试 docs 文档/评论 chore 工具、CI、依赖项、内务处理 ci 工作流程文件更改 perf 表演工作
  • 主语：祈使语气，无句号，小写（名词/专有名称除外）。
  • 正文（可选）：内容和原因，而不是如何。 Closes #123 的参考问题。
  • 保持每次提交的重点；每次提交一个逻辑更改。
  • 提交消息仅以英文书写——这是一条硬性规定。

docs.title: 5. 拉取请求清单
docs.text:
每个 PR 必须满足存储库模板 (.github/pull_request_template.md)：

  • [ ] Branch is up-to-date with main
  • [ ] Summary describes the change; related issues linked
  • [ ] Type of change flagged (bug / feature / docs / tests / refactor / CI / i18n)
  • [ ] ./vendor/bin/phpunit — all tests pass
  • [ ] Coverage does not drop below 90%
  • [ ] composer phpstan — Level 8 check passes
  • [ ] composer rector:types:check — no PHPDoc type changes required
  • [ ] Manual smoke test performed (described in the PR)
  • [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
  • [ ] New features include tests
  • [ ] API changes documented with #[OA\*] attributes
  • [ ] Behaviour changes reflected in docs/ai/context.md where appropriate
  • [ ] i18n translation keys added for new user-facing messages (en, zh, zh_Hant, ja)

docs.title: 6. CI Pipeline
docs.text: Three workflows live in .github/workflows/. All are path-triggered — unrelated changes do not re-run the whole pipeline.

docs.title: 6.1 ci.yml — PHPStan + PHPUnit (with coverage) + Rector
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/master and pull requests against main, master, or dev, limited to these paths:

src/**            tests/**          config/**         migrations/**
bin/**            composer.json     composer.lock     symfony.lock
phpunit.dist.xml  phpstan.neon      phpstan-bootstrap.php
rector*.php       .env.test         .github/workflows/ci.yml

Jobs (PHP 8.4 on ubuntu-latest):

Job What it runs Notes phpstan composer phpstan DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///.../var/phpstan.db tests composer install → boot Postgres 16 service → create app_test_1..4 → run ParaTest with 4 workers + PCOV coverage → enforce 90% line threshold matrix: php: ['8.4'] rector composer rector:types:check (dry-run) DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///.../var/rector.db

The parallel test job in detail:

  1. shivammathur/setup-php with coverage: pcov, ini-values: pcov.directory=src — so PCOV measures only application code under src/.
  2. A postgres:16 service container is started with app/app_secret credentials and health checks.
  3. app_test_1 … app_test_4 databases are created via psql.
  4. Tests run with:
PCOV_ENABLED=1 PARATEST=1 php vendor/bin/paratest \
  --processes=4 --coverage-text=/tmp/coverage.txt --display-deprecations

Each ParaTest worker (tokens 1–4) gets its own Postgres database through PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE=postgresql://.../app_test_{token}?... — concurrent schema drops/creates can never race. 5. The 90% gate parses Lines: <pct> from the coverage text and fails via bc comparison if it drops below 90.0.

Full env for the tests job mirrors .env.test (JWT keys at tests/Identity/Security/, APP_ENV=test, MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN=doctrine://default?auto_setup=0, MAILER_DSN=null://null, OTP_REDIS_DSN, Aliyun SMS test values with dry-run on).

docs.title: 6.2 migrations.yml — MySQL migration chain
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/master and PRs against main/master/dev, on migrations/**, config/**, bin/**, composer.json, composer.lock, symfony.lock, and the workflow file itself.

Job mysql-migration-chain:

  1. Start mysql:8.4 service (crud_skeleton_test database, user app/app).
  2. composer install with DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@127.0.0.1:3306/crud_skeleton_test?serverVersion=8.4&charset=utf8mb4.
  3. php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction --env=dev
  4. php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status --env=dev

This proves the full migration chain works against a real MySQL 8.4 instance (downstream of the schema-tool-based test schema).

docs.title: 6.3 docs.yml — Docs build & GitHub Pages deploy
docs.text:
Triggers — push to main/dev and PRs against main/master/dev, on docs/**, README*.md, scripts/build-docs.sh, scripts/translate-docs.py, mkdocs.yml, and the workflow file itself.

Job Runs on Action build pull_request only pip install mkdocs-material deep-translator → bash scripts/build-docs.sh (bilingual site build) deploy push only same build, then peaceiris/actions-gh-pages publishes ./site to the gh-pages branch

scripts/translate-docs.py + build-docs.sh produce the bilingual (English/Chinese) mkdocs site — do not bypass it by committing generated files.

docs.title: 7. Local vs CI Database
docs.text:
Context Database How it is isolated tests job (CI) PostgreSQL 16 (app_test_1..4) one DB per ParaTest token Local parallel run SQLite per worker (var/test_paratest_{pid}.db) one file per process Local serial run SQLite (var/test.db) single file

tests/bootstrap.php decides: if PARATEST=1 and no explicit DATABASE_URL template is provided, it switches each worker to its own var/test_paratest_{pid}.db and eagerly creates the schema. When CI provides PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE, it substitutes the worker token instead. An explicit DATABASE_URL from the real environment is never clobbered by the sqlite fallback.

Coverage is always measured with PCOV (PCOV_ENABLED=1 / coverage: pcov). Xdebug-based coverage (XDEBUG_MODE=coverage) works locally but is not used in CI.

docs.title: 8. Definition of Done
docs.text:
A change is done when, on top of the PR checklist:

  1. composer phpstan — Level 8 clean (no new baseline entries without justification).
  2. composer rector:types:check — no required type-rule changes.
  3. ./vendor/bin/phpunit (or PARATEST=1 ./vendor/bin/paratest --processes 8 --runner WrapperRunner) — green, coverage ≥ 90% Lines.
  4. Migration chain verified against MySQL (CI migrations.yml job).
  5. OpenAPI #[OA\*] attributes updated for any endpoint change.
  6. User-facing strings have translation keys (en, zh, zh_Hant, ja).

docs.title: 从整体中提取服务
docs.text:
CRUD Skeleton 是一个 单一模块化整体 — 一个 Symfony 应用程序，一个作曲家 项目，一棵带有命名空间模块的 src/ 树（App\Trade、App\Wallet、 App\Settlement，...）。它不是一个多应用程序单一存储库。本指南解释了 如何使用一个模块并将其变成一个独立的服务/应用程序 以现有模块边界为蓝图。

好消息：代码库的设计使这成为可能。的 结算 ↔ 钱包关系是服务的一个工作示例 边界看起来像。本指南正式化了该过程。

docs.title: 1.预提取规则
docs.text: 在移动任何代码之前，模块必须已经是边界干净的。以下 三个规则使得拔牙变得机械化而不是手术化。

docs.title: 1.1 无跨模块学说关联
docs.text:
实体决不与另一个实体中的实体保持 ORM 关联 模块。没有 ManyToOne/OneToMany 属性指向外部 模块，并且不同模块拥有的表之间没有外键。

检查是否有违规行为：

# In the module you intend to extract, grep for cross-module entity imports
rg "use App\\\\(Trade|Payment|Store|Inventory|Identity)\\\\Entity" src/Settlement

目标模块中的每个表都必须是独立的。跨模块查找 是通过 UUID 或标量引用 手动完成的，而不是通过连接键。

docs.title: 1.2 UUID 引用而不是对象/ID 链接
docs.text:
实体内部的外部身份是一个包含远程信息的纯字符串列 聚合的 UUID，不是数据库级外键，也不是对象引用。

src/Settlement/Entity/SettlementAllocation.php 是典型的例子：

#[ORM\Column(name: 'uuid', type: 'string', length: 36)]
private string $uuid;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'plan_uuid', type: 'string', length: 36)]
private string $planUuid;

#[ORM\Column(name: 'rule_version_uuid', type: 'string', length: 36, nullable: true)]
private ?string $ruleVersionUuid;
  • 本地行保留整数代理键 (id) 和 UUID。
  • 远程身份存储为 string(36) UUID 列，并建立索引以供查找。
  • 永远不要假设引用的行存在；服务层重新验证。

使用类型/id 对来表示事物是所使用的模式 结算合约 — SettlementSubject 是 type : id 作为字符串：

final readonly class SettlementSubject
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $type,
        public string $id,
        public string $version,
    ) { }
}

docs.title: 1.3 跨边界的标量合约
docs.text:
模块通过接口和不可变的 DTO 进行交互——绝不是通过 实例化另一个模块的实体或调用另一个模块的服务 直接。跨模块合约位于 Contract/ 中（只读值对象） 和 Port/ （消费者实现或注入的接口）。

结算定义了它需要的边界：

  • src/Settlement/Contract/* - ConfirmedAllocation，PostedAllocation， ReversalRequest、VoucherPostingReceipt、SettlementSubject、...全部 final readonly class 仅包含标量的 DTO。
  • src/Settlement/Port/SettlementVoucherPort.php — 拥有的接口 结算，由托管方（钱包）执行：
interface SettlementVoucherPort
{
    public function post(ConfirmedAllocation $allocation): VoucherPostingReceipt;
    public function reverse(PostedAllocation $allocation, ReversalRequest $request): VoucherPostingReceipt;
}

该实现位于消费者自己的命名空间中： src/Wallet/Integration/Settlement/WalletSettlementVoucherPort.php。主持人 模块拥有实现；消费模块拥有该接口。

规则 1.3 的结果： 一个只涉及 Contract/* 的模块 来自其他模块的 Port/* 可以被取出并指向不同的主机 实现（一个 HTTP 客户端、另一个服务、测试中的假冒），无需 改变自己的代码。

docs.title: 2. 选择模块并映射其边界
docs.text:
src/Settlement 是第一次提取的最佳候选者，因为它是 最独立的。它的布局是模板：

src/Settlement/
├── Command/          # app:settlement:* console commands (scheduler loop)
├── Context/          # SettlementContextResolver registry pattern
├── Contract/         # immutable cross-module DTOs (scalar-only)
├── Controller/       # API controllers (Manage/ namespace)
├── Entity/           # Doctrine entities — self-contained tables
├── Exception/        # module exception hierarchy
├── Integration/      # Fake/ and Fixture/ test doubles
├── Message/          # Messenger message classes (async)
├── MessageHandler/   # MessageHandler::__invoke consumers
├── Port/             # interfaces the module depends on (implemented elsewhere)
├── Repository/       # Doctrine repositories
├── Resources/config/ # services_settlement.yaml (service wiring)
└── Service/          # domain services + *ServiceInterface aliases

其他模块遵循相同的形状（钱包、贸易、库存、商店……）， 每个都有相同的子命名空间。唯一的区别是细节——例如 钱包将 Service/ 拆分为 Deposit/、Withdraw/、Transfer/、 Payment/功能文件夹并具有应用程序Controller/和管理Controller/。

docs.title: 映射依赖关系
docs.text:
对于每个模块，有两个列表：

  1. 它依赖于其他什么 — 合约、端口和消息 进口。对于结算，这些是无；只取决于它自己 Contract//Port/。 （钱包则相反：它实现 SettlementVoucherPort并消耗App\Settlement\Contract\*。）
  2. 其他人依赖它 - 谁实现它的端口 (App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort)，谁 使用它的合约，以及它的哪些消息被路由到 config/packages/messenger.yaml。

“依赖于其他”列表为空（或仅合同）的模块是 可按原样提取。端口指向的模块（结算←钱包）保留 它的域并在接线时交换端口实现。

docs.title: 每个模块的提取清单
docs.text:
• [ ] 模块内没有 use App\...\Entity 跨模块导入
  • [ ] 所有跨模块引用都是Contract/*和Port/*
  • [ ] 每个出站事件都是一个 OutboxMessage 行 + Messenger 消息
  • [ ] 每个入站事件均从收件箱/已消耗事件表中消耗
  • [ ] 命令名称遵循 app:{module}:{...} 并列在 compose.yaml 中
  • [ ] Resources/config/services_{module}.yaml 保存所有模块接线
  • [ ] config/services.yaml App\|: 自动装配仅排除基础类

docs.title: 3. 创建应用程序骨架
docs.text:
创建一个新的独立 Symfony 应用程序（或在 monorepo 中创建一个新的 Composer 包） 顶级）将托管该模块：

composer create-project symfony/skeleton settlement-service
cd settlement-service
composer require symfony/orm-pack symfony/messenger symfony/translation

您正在复制的内容（按顺序）：

  1. src/Kernel.php — MicroKernel 引导程序。
  2. composer.json — 自动加载 PSR-4 地图："App\\": "src/"。
  3. config/services.yaml — 导入模块配置+全局自动装配。
  4. 模块配置接线（参见Wiring）。

框架故意被最小化：没有 templates/，没有 webpack，什么都没有 API 框架超出了模块实际使用的部分。

docs.title: 4.移动代码
docs.text:
将模块的目录物理移动到新应用程序中：

# Inside the new app
mkdir -p src
mv ../crud-skeleton/src/Settlement src/Settlement

因为模块是命名空间隔离的 (App\Settlement\...)，所以命名空间 零重命名后保持有效。保留它 App\Settlement 除非你愿意 重命名新服务的根命名空间；如果这样做，命名空间重命名是 机械查找/替换。

docs.title: 移动必须跟随的部分
docs.text: 随模块一起发货 示例（结算） 实体+存储库 Entity/*、Repository/* 领域服务 Service/*、Service/Money/* 服务接口+别名 *ServiceInterface + services_settlement.yaml 控制器 Controller/Manage/* 控制台命令 Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php、RequeueDuePostingCommand.php 消息+处理程序 Message/*、MessageHandler/* 合同和港口 Contract/*、Port/* 测试双打 Integration/Fake/*、Integration/Fixture/* 模块迁移文件 migrations/Version2026...*.php（结算表）

docs.title: 留下
docs.text:
• 其他模块拥有的端口实现。 钱包的 WalletSettlementVoucherPort 留在整体中（或者变成一个小的 萃取上游的适配器）。结算从不直接进口； 这取决于接口App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort。
  • 任何非特定于模块的全局自动装配 (config/services.yaml App\: 块，_instanceof 标记规则）。这些仅以新的形式移动 应用程序需要自己的模块。

docs.title: 5. 基线迁移
docs.text:
该模块的表当前位于单体的单一迁移中 历史。在提取之前，生成一个基线，以便新服务可以 仅从其自己的模式开始。

  1. **将创建/修改模块表的所有迁移压缩为一个 新应用程序内的新 Version{time}BaselineSettlement.php：
final class Version20260820000000BaselineSettlement extends AbstractMigration
{
    public function up(Schema $schema): void
    {
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_plan (...)
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_rule (...)
        // CREATE TABLE settlement_allocation (...)
        // ... module tables only
    }
}

  1. 从整体迁移中删除模块的表语句 导出数据的直接迁移之后的历史记录。保留 Monolith 的历史线性：提取版本带来了一次迁移 将数据迁移出去后，新服务会进行一次基线迁移。

  2. 从第一次部署新服务时将 version_control 设置为开启： doctrine:migrations:version --add --all 应用基线后，或 latest_as_of 在迁移配置中，因此独立历史记录匹配 内置架构。

  3. 使用与 .github/workflows/migrations.yml 相同的作业模式进行验证： 将链从头开始应用于新的 MySQL 8.4 并断言 doctrine:migrations:status 报告最新的基线。

docs.title: 6. 接线
docs.text:
在新应用程序中重现模块的服务接线。每个模块都拥有一个 已包含其依赖关系图的配置文件：

  • src/Core/Resources/config/services.yaml
  • src/Identity/Resources/config/services_identity.yaml
  • src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml
  • ...每个模块一个

src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml 显示模式：

services:
    _defaults:
        autowire: true
        autoconfigure: true

    App\Settlement\Service\SettlementServiceInterface:
        alias: App\Settlement\Service\SettlementService

    # ...

    App\Settlement\Port\ClockInterface:
        alias: App\Settlement\Service\SystemClock

    App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort:
        alias: App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort   # <-- host impl

    when@test:
        services:
            App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort:
                public: true
            App\Settlement\Port\SettlementVoucherPort:
                alias: App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort

从 config/services.yaml 导入：

imports:
    - { resource: '../src/Settlement/Resources/config/services_settlement.yaml', ignore_errors: true }

docs.title: 重新指向端口
docs.text:
在整体中，SettlementVoucherPort 的别名是 App\Wallet\Integration\Settlement\WalletSettlementVoucherPort。在新的 服务，端口必须解析为随服务一起提供的实现：

  • 迁移过程中：如果您也移动了电子钱包适配器，请保留它 进入新应用程序（它拉入钱包实体/服务 - 事实上是一个钱包 提取也）。
  • 独立服务：针对新服务自己实现端口 存储或对钱包服务的出站 HTTP 调用：
final class HttpSettlementVoucherPort implements SettlementVoucherPort
{
    public function post(ConfirmedAllocation $allocation): VoucherPostingReceipt { /* POST to wallet.svc /api/... */ }
    public function reverse(PostedAllocation $allocation, ReversalRequest $request): VoucherPostingReceipt { /* ... */ }
}

并更改 services_settlement.yaml 中的别名。无结算代码 变化——这就是端口间接的全部意义。

docs.title: 消息传递
docs.text: 将 config/packages/messenger.yaml 中的模块条目移动到新应用程序 （例如routing: App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage: async）。 在整体中，删除这些路由，如果模块的消息现在是 流程外交付，通过集成替换剩余的消费者 点（webhook/HTTP 调度或共享传输）。

docs.title: 调度程序和控制台命令
docs.text:
已导出的命令 (app:settlement:...) 由 scheduler服务于compose.yaml。在新的部署中：

  • 从整体的scheduler循环中移除沉降线。
  • 在运行的新服务中添加scheduler（或主机cron） app:settlement:outbox:publish 和 app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due 在相同的循环模式上：
while :; do
  php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
  php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
  sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
done

docs.title: 7. 测试
docs.text:
The module already ships its own test doubles, so the new service can test the module in complete isolation:

  • App\Settlement\Integration\Fake\InMemorySettlementVoucherPort — implements the host port with no database.
  • App\Settlement\Integration\Fixture\FundingSnapshotContextResolver — a tagged settlement.context_resolver fixture for integration tests.

Reuse the monolith's testing conventions (see docs/design/system-contracts.md §7 and docs/testing/crud-skeleton-production/):

Contract Requirement Coverage ≥ 90% line coverage, enforced in CI Test DB Clean schema per test, built by schema tool Unit tests PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase — no kernel Kernel tests IntegrationKernelTestCase — booted kernel Web tests IntegrationWebTestCase — full HTTP cycle when@test wiring Ports/fakes + when@test sections in the module config

Copy the relevant test files from tests/UnitTest/Settlement and tests/Integration that exercise the module, then delete them from the monolith. Static analysis stays identical:

composer phpstan            # Level 8, isolated SQLite DATABASE_URL
composer rector:types:check # Rector type rules dry-run

docs.title: 8. CI
docs.text:
The monolith's CI is three jobs in .github/workflows/*. Re-produce them in the new repo:

Job Source workflow Command Static analysis ci.yml → phpstan composer phpstan (PHP 8.4, SQLite DB URL) Rector ci.yml → rector composer rector:types:check (SQLite DB URL) Tests ci.yml → tests Paratest with coverage ≥ 90%, PostgreSQL 16 Migrations migrations.yml Fresh MySQL 8.4 chain apply + status

Reference DATABASE_URL values used by CI:

# phpstan / rector (no DB server needed)
DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///%kernel.project_dir%/var/phpstan.db"

# tests matrix
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app:app_secret@127.0.0.1:5432/app_test?serverVersion=16&charset=utf8"
PARATEST_DATABASE_URL_TEMPLATE="postgresql://app:app_secret@127.0.0.1:5432/app_test_{token}?serverVersion=16&charset=utf8"

# migrations
DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:app@127.0.0.1:3306/...?serverVersion=8.4&charset=utf8mb4"

docs.title: 9. Docker
docs.text:
Re-use the existing Dockerfile and compose layout as the template for the new service. The production picture after extraction:

# monolith compose.yaml — Settlement lines removed from scheduler's loop,
# Settlement messages removed from messenger routing
scheduler:
  command:
    - /bin/sh
    - -ec
    - |
      while :; do
        php bin/console app:trade:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:store:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:reservations:release-expired --no-interaction
        sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
      done

# settlement-service compose.yaml — same shapes, own database volume
services:
  app:
    build: .                     # same Dockerfile style
    environment: &app-env
      APP_ENV: prod
      APP_SECRET: ${APP_SECRET:?required}
      DATABASE_URL: "mysql://...@settlement-db:3306/..."
      MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN: ${MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN:?required}   # shared/broker
    volumes:
      - ./var:/var/www/html/var   # JWT keys + cache, persisted

  worker:
    extends: { service: app }
    command: ["php", "bin/console", "messenger:consume", "async", "--time-limit=3600", "--memory-limit=256M", "--no-interaction"]

  scheduler:
    extends: { service: app }
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -ec
      - |
        while :; do
          php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
          php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
          sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
        done

  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ["${APP_PORT:-8081}:80"]      # separate port from the monolith
    volumes:
      - ./public:/var/www/html/public:ro
      - ./docker/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://localhost/health/ready"]

  settlement-db:
    image: mysql:${MYSQL_VERSION:-8.4}
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${MYSQL_DATABASE:-settlement}
      MYSQL_USER: ${MYSQL_USER:-app}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD:?required}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:?required}
    volumes: [settlement_db_data:/var/lib/mysql]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine

  mailer:
    image: axllent/mailpit

networks:
  internal:

volumes:
  settlement_db_data:

Key points carried over unchanged:

  • The entrypoint (JWT key bootstrap + prod validation) and healthcheck endpoints (/health/live, /health/ready) move with the app — they live in src/Core, so copy src/Core (or at least the parts the module uses) with the extraction.
  • nginx publishes on its own host port and health-checks through /health/ready.
  • Cross-service messaging is the only genuinely new piece: the two services either share a transport (same MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN broker) or the consuming service calls a port implementation via HTTP.
  • Production rollout is additive: deploy the new service, migrate the data (one cutover migration on the monolith, one baseline on the new service), then remove the module's scheduler lines, messenger routes, and tables.

docs.title: Practice: Settlement vs Wallet
docs.text:
Concern Settlement (extract first) Wallet (currently the host) Owns contracts Contract/*, Port/SettlementVoucherPort consumes App\Settlement\Contract\* Implements ports — Integration/Settlement/WalletSettlementVoucherPort DB tables settlement_* only, no FKs out wallet_*, voucher_*, transaction_*, ... Cross-module refs UUID columns (plan_uuid, rule_version_uuid) deposit('settlement', ...) + voucher fields Async edges outbox publish + SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage, SettlementAllocationPostingMessage consumes settlement postings synchronously via port Test seams InMemorySettlementVoucherPort, FundingSnapshotContextResolver — (it provides them)

Extracting Settlement = taking the domain, contracts, commands, and test doubles, implementing SettlementVoucherPort as an HTTP/queue adapter, and shipping its baseline migration + CI + compose. Because Wallet only ever touches Settlement through Contract/* and Port/SettlementVoucherPort, the monolith side needs no business-logic changes — only the alias in services_settlement.yaml (which leaves the monolith) and the messenger routing entries (which leave the monolith).

Extracting Wallet (a later step) then uses the identical recipe, with the extra step that the module that hosted its port (Settlement) must now call it remotely.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: This page gets the application running and shows you how to verify it works. Two paths are supported: Docker Compose (recommended, everything included) and native PHP (uses a locally installed PHP toolchain).

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Tool Version Purpose Docker Engine + Compose v2 latest stable Runs the full service stack (compose.yaml) PHP 8.4+ (project constraint >=8.4) Native setup; the CLI requires pdo_mysql, openssl, zip, intl extensions Composer 2.x Dependency and autoload management OpenSSL any recent Generates the RSA JWT key pair MySQL 8 client 8.x Optional — native mysql CLI for inspecting the container database

On macOS with Homebrew this project has been tested against PHP 8.5 (/opt/homebrew/opt/php). PHP 8.4 from Homebrew works too — see Troubleshooting if php resolves to an older version.

docs.title: Services in compose.yaml
docs.text:
docker compose up -d --build starts a single networked stack. Only nginx, database, redis, and mailer publish host ports; the PHP containers never do.

Service Image / Build Purpose Host port (default) app built from Dockerfile PHP-FPM serving the Symfony API — worker same image Messenger consumer for the async transport — scheduler same image Loop running outbox-publish and reservation/settlement housekeeping — nginx nginx:alpine Reverse proxy to PHP-FPM; serves / → public/ ${APP_PORT:-8080}:80 database mysql:8.4 Primary storage (Doctrine) 3306:3306 via compose.override.yaml redis redis:7-alpine Cache, OTP storage, rate limiter backing — mailer axllent/mailpit Email catcher (Mailpit UI) ${MAILPIT_UI_PORT:-8025}:8025

worker and scheduler extends: app, so they share the same image and environment. nginx has a full-path readiness probe through to GET /health/ready.

docs.title: Docker Quick Start
docs.text:
# 1. Build images and start every service
docker compose up -d --build

# 2. Apply the latest database schema
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

# 3. Create an administrator account (email, screen name, password)
docker compose exec app php bin/console app:identity:user:create admin@example.com admin 'P@ssw0rd' --admin

That is enough to log in and exercise the API. The JWT key pair is generated automatically on first container start by docker/app/entrypoint.sh into var/jwt/. No environment file is required for a first run — compose.yaml provides safe development defaults.

Common follow-up commands:

# Tail app logs
docker compose logs -f app

# Reset the database (dev only)
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:schema:drop --force
docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate --no-interaction

# Stop the stack (keep volumes)
docker compose down

docs.title: Native PHP Setup
docs.text:
The optional compose.override.yaml binds the source tree and exposes MySQL and Mailpit locally, but you can also run everything directly on the host:

# 1. Install dependencies (Docker is not required for this step)
composer install

# 2. Create your local environment file
cp .env .env.local

Configure .env.local before the next steps:

APP_ENV=dev
APP_SECRET=your-secret
DATABASE_URL="mysql://app:!ChangeMe!@127.0.0.1:3306/app?serverVersion=8.0&charset=utf8mb4"

JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=%kernel.project_dir%/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem
JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH=%kernel.project_dir%/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem
JWT_PASSPHRASE=
REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET=your-refresh-secret

docs.title: Generate the JWT key pair
docs.text:
The JWT authenticator signs access tokens with RS256, so a private/public RSA pair is required. Create it under var/jwt/ (.gitignored):

mkdir -p var/jwt

# Private key (optionally guarded by a passphrase)
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 \
  -out var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

# Public key derived from the private key
openssl rsa -in var/jwt/jwt_private.pem -pubout -out var/jwt/jwt_public.pem

# Restrict permissions: the private key must not be world-readable
chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem

If you set a JWT_PASSPHRASE, re-run the private-key generation with -aes256 and (optionally) -pass pass:..., and set JWT_PASSPHRASE to the same value in .env.local.

docs.title: Create the database and run migrations
docs.text:
php bin/console doctrine:database:create
php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate

docs.title: Serve the API
docs.text:
php -S localhost:8000 -t public/

In APP_ENV=dev the built-in server is enough for local work; the app is also fully functional behind nginx (see docker/nginx/default.conf for the production shape).

docs.title: JWT Environment Variables
docs.text:
Variable Default (compose) Purpose JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_private.pem Path to the RSA private key (PEM) used for signing access tokens JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH /var/www/html/var/jwt/jwt_public.pem Path to the RSA public key (PEM) used for verification JWT_PASSPHRASE (empty) Optional passphrase protecting the private key REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET dev-refresh-secret-change-me HMAC secret for refresh-token hashing and rotation ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL 7200 (seconds) Access-token lifetime REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL 31536000 (seconds) Refresh-token lifetime

Related optional variables: OTP_REDIS_DSN, ALIYUN_* (SMS), WECHAT_* (WeChat login/pay), MAILER_DSN, MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN, INVENTORY_ENABLED. See .env.example for the full reference.

docs.title: Verifying the Setup
docs.text:
# Swagger UI (also available at http://localhost:8000/api/doc natively)
curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/doc | head -c 200

# Health/readiness returns JSON when the app, DB, and Redis are reachable
curl -s http://localhost:8080/health/ready

Log in and capture a token:

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"P@ssw0rd"}'

Use the returned token for authenticated calls:

curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/v1/profile \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: 症状 可能的原因 修复 Doctrine\DBAL\Exception\DriverException: could not find driver 缺少 pdo_mysql PHP 扩展 检查php -m \| grep -i mysql。在 macOS Homebrew 上：brew install php 捆绑它；确保 /opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin/php 位于 PATH 的第一位 JWT ... key not found / 401 受保护的路由 JWT 密钥未生成，或路径不匹配 .env.local 运行上面的 openssl 命令并验证 JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH / JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH 是绝对的并指向现有的 PEM 文件 Permission denied 当应用程序读取私钥时 私钥模式太开放 chmod 600 var/jwt/jwt_private.pem （它被 git 忽略） Address already in use: 8080 / 8000 另一个进程占用了端口 docker compose — 设置APP_PORT=8090 docker compose up -d；本机 - 选择另一个端口，例如php -S localhost:8001 -t public/ php 是 macOS 上的旧版本（例如 7.4） 自制 php 未链接/第一个 运行 /opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin/php bin/console ... 或 PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/php/bin:$PATH" php ... 迁移失败并显示 Unknown database 'app' 数据库未创建 docker compose exec app php bin/console doctrine:database:create（本机：在没有 exec 的情况下运行相同的操作） 邮件未到达 Mailpit 未运行或 DSN 错误 Native：启动Mailpit（docker compose up -d mailer）并使用MAILER_DSN=smtp://127.0.0.1:1025；检查 UI http://localhost:8025

docs.title: Internationalization (i18n)
docs.text: The project uses Symfony's Translation component for user-facing strings and automatically translates the documentation into Chinese via a build pipeline. This document covers both systems.

docs.title: 1.1 Configuration
docs.text:
config/packages/translation.yaml:

framework:
    default_locale: zh
    translator:
        default_path: '%kernel.project_dir%/translations'
        providers:
  • Translations are loaded from translations/.
  • default_locale is zh — a fresh request that carries no locale signal resolves to Simplified Chinese.
  • Messages are stored as YAML files named messages.{locale}.yaml.

docs.title: 1.2 Supported locales
docs.text:
Locale File Language en translations/messages.en.yaml English zh translations/messages.zh.yaml Chinese (Simplified) zh_Hant translations/messages.zh_Hant.yaml Chinese (Traditional) ja translations/messages.ja.yaml Japanese

These four codes are the canonical SUPPORTED_LOCALES in src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php.

docs.title: 1.3 Key convention — English strings are the keys
docs.text:
Translation keys are the original English message strings themselves, not symbolic ids:

# translations/messages.en.yaml
"Wallet": "Wallet"
# translations/messages.zh.yaml
"Wallet": "钱包"

messages.en.yaml is therefore mostly documentation — it maps each key to itself — because Symfony's translator falls back to returning the key when no translation is found. The file documents every translatable string:

  • Entity names (Category, Order, Transaction, ...)
  • Entity field names (Id, Uuid, Name, Slug, camelCase → plain text)
  • Error / status messages used as exception keys

docs.title: 1.4 Where translation happens
docs.text:
The framework reads a message through $translator->trans($key) at these points:

Site Mechanism Exception responses ExceptionInterceptor — every uncaught exception on /api/* is routed through $this->translator->trans($exception->getMessage()); the exception message is the key Controller errors RestController::warning(), AuthController::error(), OtpController::error(), LoginController::error() all pass through the translator JWT failures JwtAuthenticator::onAuthenticationFailure() translates the error before returning JSON Entity metadata /system/entities/{entityName} translates field descriptions (e.g. createdAt → 创建时间)

So a service throwing new \RuntimeException('Insufficient funds') is rendered in the request locale if "Insufficient funds" exists in the corresponding locale file.

docs.title: 2. Locale detection
docs.text:
src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php runs at kernel.request (priority 20) and applies the following resolution order:

flowchart TD
    A[Request] --> B{_locale query param?}
    B -- yes, supported --> C[setLocale canonical]
    B -- yes, unsupported --> D[silently ignored<br/>request keeps default locale]
    B -- no --> E{Accept-Language header?}
    E -- yes --> F[parse by q-weight,<br/>highest supported wins]
    E -- no --> G[request keeps default_locale `zh`]
  1. ?_locale= query parameter — highest priority. A supported value (en, zh, zh_Hant, ja) is applied directly; an unsupported one is ignored (the request keeps its existing locale). This also short-circuits the header check.
  2. Accept-Language header — parsed (q-weight respected, highest first) and mapped to a canonical locale:
Header value Canonical zh-CN, zh-Hans zh zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-Hant, zh-Hant-TW zh_Hant en-US, en-GB en ja-JP, ja_JP ja

A bare zh/en/ja/zh_Hant also resolves (they are in SUPPORTED_LOCALES directly). The mapping table is LOCALE_MAP in the listener. 3. Fallback — if nothing matches, the request keeps the framework default_locale, configured as zh.

Note: the listener's PHPDoc and the README (§"Internationalization") say the fallback is en. The actual runtime config in config/packages/translation.yaml sets default_locale: zh, so unsupported or absent locale signals currently resolve to Simplified Chinese, not English. If you change default_locale, update both the config and the comment to stay consistent.

Only main requests are processed ($event->isMainRequest()); subrequests (ESI etc.) are left untouched.

docs.title: 3.1 Add a new key to existing locales
docs.text:
1. Use the English string as the key in messages.en.yaml (key = value).
  2. Add the same key with the translated value to messages.zh.yaml, messages.zh_Hant.yaml, messages.ja.yaml.
  3. Throw the exception / return the message from the service layer; the existing interceptor/controller paths translate it for you.

docs.title: 3.2 Add a new language
docs.text:
1. Create translations/messages.{locale}.yaml. Symfony auto-discovers files in the translations/ directory — no config registration is required.
  2. Add the locale code to SUPPORTED_LOCALES and, if you want verbose codes like xx-XX to map to it, add an entry to LOCALE_MAP in src/Core/EventListener/LocaleListener.php.

docs.title: 4. Translated documentation pipeline
docs.text: The docs (docs/, English Markdown) are mirrored to docs-zh/ (Chinese) by a script, and both are built into a bilingual static site with mkdocs.

docs.title: 4.1 scripts/translate-docs.py
docs.text:
Mirrors docs/ → docs-zh/ using the free deep-translator Google endpoint (no API key).

  • 先决条件： pip install deep-translator
  • 用途： 
    python scripts/translate-docs.py                          # full mirror
python scripts/translate-docs.py design/bundles/payment.md # single file
  • 跳过research/和ai/目录。
  • 保留：YAML frontmatter、围栏代码块、内联代码、HTML 注释、 图像和链接 - 每个都在翻译之前“隐藏”并在翻译之后恢复， 所以代码和 URL 永远不会被破坏。
  • 将正文拆分为段落并按块进行翻译（< 4500 个字符到 遵守免费 API 限制）。失败的块保留为原始英语 带有 WARN 行。

docs.title: 4.2 scripts/build-docs.sh
docs.text:
完整的双语版本（bash scripts/build-docs.sh）。它：

  1. 运行 translate-docs.py（文档 → 文档-zh）。
  2. 复制不应翻译的二进制/文本资源（assets/、 research/、openapi/、ai/、javascripts/)从docs/到docs-zh/。
  3. 从单个 mkdocs.yml 生成两个 mkdocs 配置：
  4. mkdocs-en.yml — 英语，site_dir: site，添加语言 alternate 链接 (/crud-skeleton/ ↔ /crud-skeleton/zh/)。
  5. mkdocs-zh.yml — docs_dir: docs-zh、site_dir: site/zh、 主题 language: zh，通过静态 MAP 翻译的导航标签 (Home → 首页, Wallet → Wallet (钱包), ...) 未知短标签的谷歌翻译后备。
  6. 构建两者，mkdocs build -f ... --clean。

输出：

网站 配置 URL（本地预览） 英语 mkdocs-en.yml site/index.html 中文 mkdocs-zh.yml site/zh/index.html

topic/nav 的真实来源是 mkdocs.yml （site_name: CRUD Skeleton，Material 主题，美人鱼支持来自 extra_javascript）。生成的mkdocs-en.yml / mkdocs-zh.yml是 构建工件 - 编辑 mkdocs.yml （以及 build-docs.sh 中的 MAP）并 重新运行脚本。

docs.title: 4.3 翻译自述文件
docs.text:
该存储库还提供手动维护的翻译自述文件变体（请参阅自述文件） §“国际化”）：

语言 文件 中文（简体） README.zh-cn.md 中文（繁体） README.zh-hant.md 日语 README.ja.md

这些独立于 docs-zh/ 机器翻译并得到维护 手动。

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• API字符串：key为translations/messages.*.yaml中的英文消息字符串； 四个区域设置（en、zh、zh_Hant、ja），默认 zh。
  • 检测：?_locale= → Accept-Language（q 加权，通过映射 LOCALE_MAP) → 框架default_locale。
  • 文档：docs/→docs-zh/通过translate-docs.py；双语网站建立者 build-docs.sh 分为 site/ 和 site/zh/。

docs.title: Integration Events (Outbox / Inbox Pattern)
docs.text:
Modules in this project (Trade, Store, Inventory, Settlement, Wallet, Payment) share one Kernel, one Doctrine EntityManager, and one Messenger bus, but they must not reach into each other's entities or repositories. Cross-module communication is event-driven and durable: a module emits facts it owns through outboxes and consumes facts from other modules through inboxes, connected by Symfony Messenger.

The pattern protects against two failure modes:

  • Lost events — an event is written in the same DB transaction as the business change (transactional outbox), so it is never lost even if the process dies mid-flight.
  • Duplicate delivery — consumers record a consumed-event row in the same transaction as the business effect, keyed by eventId (idempotent inbox).
flowchart LR
    subgraph Producer["Producer (module A)"]
        A[Business operation]
        O[Outbox table<br/>*_outbox_message]
        P[Publish command<br/>app:*:outbox:publish]
    end

    subgraph Consumer["Consumer (module B)"]
        H[Worker / handlers]
        I[Inbox table<br/>*_consumed_event]
        B[Business effect]
    end

    A -- "same DB transaction" --> O
    O -- "poll + claim" --> P
    P -- "Messenger 'async'<br/>(Doctrine transport)" --> H
    H -- "same DB transaction" --> I
    H -- "apply" --> B
  • Producer side (outbox): *OutboxService::record(topic, aggregateType, aggregateId, payload) inserts a row into the module's *_outbox_message table. A publish command (app:<module>:outbox:publish, one per module) polls the table, claims rows, builds an envelope, and dispatches a Messenger message onto the async transport.
  • Consumer side (inbox): a #[AsMessageHandler] validates the envelope, checks the module's *_consumed_event table for the eventId, and inside one DB transaction both applies the effect and records the consumed-event row.

docs.title: 1. Transport configuration
docs.text:
config/packages/messenger.yaml:

framework:
    messenger:
        failure_transport: failed          # dead-letter queue (doctrine://default?queue_name=failed)

        transports:
            async:
                dsn: '%env(MESSENGER_TRANSPORT_DSN)%'   # default: doctrine://default?auto_setup=0
                options:
                    use_notify: true
                    check_delayed_interval: 60000
                retry_strategy:
                    max_retries: 3
                    multiplier: 2
            failed: 'doctrine://default?queue_name=failed'

        routing:
            App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCreatedMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCancelledMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\StoreOrderAcceptedMessage: async
            App\Trade\Message\StoreOrderRejectedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRequestedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationConfirmedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRejectedMessage: async
            App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleasedMessage: async
            App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage: async
            App\Settlement\Message\SettlementAllocationPostingMessage: async
  • All integration messages route to the single async transport (a Doctrine table messenger_messages), consumed by the worker Compose service: messenger:consume async --time-limit=3600 --memory-limit=256M.
  • Messenger applies its own in-transport retry (3 retries, exponential multiplier 2); exhausted messages go to the failed transport.
  • The outbox adds its own claim/defer layer on top (see Publishing flow) so the same envelope is never handed to Messenger twice, even if two scheduler ticks race.

docs.title: 2.1 Message classes
docs.text:
Most module messages are thin final readonly carriers of a single array $envelope:

final readonly class TradeOrderCreatedMessage
{
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $envelope */
    public function __construct(public array $envelope) {}
}
Message Produced by Consumed by Envelope-based App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCreatedMessage Trade outbox Store ✅ envelope App\Trade\Message\TradeOrderCancelledMessage Trade outbox Store ✅ envelope App\Store\Message… → StoreOrderAcceptedMessage, StoreOrderRejectedMessage Store outbox Trade ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRequestedMessage Store outbox Inventory ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage Store outbox Inventory ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationConfirmedMessage Inventory outbox Store ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationRejectedMessage Inventory outbox Store ✅ envelope App\Inventory\Message\ReservationReleasedMessage Inventory outbox Store ✅ envelope App\Settlement\Message\SettlementAllocationPostingMessage Settlement outbox Settlement ❌ explicit fields (allocationUuid, planUuid) App\Settlement\Message\SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage external producer (async) Settlement ❌ explicit fields

The Store message classes live in the Target module's namespace are imported into the producer command; e.g. StoreOrderAcceptedMessage/StoreOrderRejectedMessage are App\Trade\Message\* classes consumed by App\Trade\MessageHandler\*, while ReservationRequestedMessage/ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage are App\Inventory\Message\* consumed by App\Inventory\MessageHandler\*.

docs.title: 2.2 Envelope structure
docs.text:
The publish commands assemble a versioned envelope from the outbox row. The Trade publisher shows the fullest shape:

$envelope = [
    'eventId'       => $message->getEventId(),                       // UUID v4, unique
    'type'          => str_replace('.v1', '', $message->getTopic()), // 'trade.order.created'
    'version'       => 1,
    'occurredAt'    => $message->getOccurredAt()->format(DATE_ATOM), // ISO-8601
    'aggregateType' => 'trade_order',
    'aggregateId'   => $message->getAggregateId(),                   // source aggregate uuid
    'correlationId' => $message->getAggregateId(),                   // trace scope
    'causationId'   => null,                                         // parent event (none at source)
    'payload'       => $message->getPayload(),
];
Envelope key Trade Store Inventory Purpose eventId ✅ ✅ ✅ UUID v4; idempotency key for the inbox type ✅ ✅ ✅ Topic without the .v1 suffix version ✅ ✅ ✅ 1 occurredAt ✅ — — When the source fact happened (ISO-8601 ATOM) aggregateType ✅ — — Source aggregate kind aggregateId ✅ ✅ ✅ Source aggregate uuid correlationId ✅ — — Trace scope (set to the order uuid by Trade) causationId ✅ — — Parent event id (null for source events) payload ✅ ✅ ✅ Business data (array)

aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, occurred_at, available_at, published_at, attempts, and last_error are also persisted in the outbox table itself.

The Settlement AllocationPostingMessage and SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage instead carry explicit scalar fields rather than an envelope (see Settlement flow).

docs.title: 2.3 Topic catalogue
docs.text: Topic (.v1 suffix = version) Emitter outbox Consumer trade.order.created.v1 trade_outbox_message Store (TradeOrderCreatedHandler) trade.order.cancelled.v1 trade_outbox_message Store (TradeOrderCancelledHandler) store.order.accepted.v1 store_outbox_message Trade (StoreOrderAcceptedHandler) store.order.rejected.v1 store_outbox_message Trade (StoreOrderRejectedHandler) inventory.reservation.requested.v1 store_outbox_message Inventory (ReservationRequestedHandler) inventory.reservation.release.requested.v1 store_outbox_message Inventory (ReservationReleaseRequestedHandler) inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1 inventory_outbox_message Store (ReservationConfirmedHandler) inventory.reservation.rejected.v1 inventory_outbox_message Store (ReservationRejectedHandler) inventory.reservation.released.v1 inventory_outbox_message Store (ReservationReleasedHandler) settlement.allocation.post.requested.v1 settlement_outbox_message Settlement (SettlementAllocationPostingHandler) settlement.funding.confirmed.v1 — (async, external) Settlement (SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler)

docs.title: 3. Publishing flow
docs.text:
每个带有发件箱的模块都有一个 Command/PublishOutboxCommand.php 注册为 app:<module>:outbox:publish。 compose.yaml 中的调度程序每隔 OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL（默认5）。

scheduler:
  extends:
    service: app
  command:
    - /bin/sh
    - -ec
    - |
      while :; do
        php bin/console app:trade:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:store:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:inventory:reservations:release-expired --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due --no-interaction
        php bin/console app:settlement:outbox:publish --no-interaction
        sleep "${OUTBOX_PUBLISH_INTERVAL:-5}"
      done

三个标准步骤（与贸易、商店、库存、结算相同）：

  1. 选择早于其 available_at 的未发布行 （findUnpublished() — published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100）。
  2. Claim — claim($id, now + 1 minute) 运行一个原子 UPDATE … SET available_at = :until WHERE id = :id AND published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now 仅当更新一行时才返回 true。这是并发防护： 第二个刻度（或重新启动的调度程序）将跳过其他工作人员已声明的行。
  3. 调度匹配的总线消息。成功markPublished()邮票 published_at。关于任何\Throwable（或不受支持的主题）defer($id, $error, now + 5 min) 递增 attempts，存储 last_error，并将 available_at 推出，以便该行 可以稍后重试。最后 EntityManager 被刷新一次。

Trade 的发布者还将主题列入白名单，并将其他任何内容视为不受支持的主题：

if (!in_array($message->getTopic(), ['trade.order.created.v1', 'trade.order.cancelled.v1'], true)) {
    $this->repository->defer($id, 'Unsupported Trade outbox topic: ' . $message->getTopic(), new \DateTimeImmutable('+5 minutes'));
    continue;
}

Inventory 发布者是异常值：它选择 数组投影 (findUnpublishedForPublishing()) 并标记通过直接发布/记录的尝试 存储库更新而不是通过工作单元，因此它不会刷新实体状态。

交付保证与订购。 交付至少一次并在 1 分钟内重试 索取租约和 5 分钟退让。尽最大努力在id之前按发件箱订购；消费者 必须是顺序容忍的（它们保护工作流/状态 can()），这正是 处理程序会这样做。

docs.title: 4.1 收件箱（消费事件）表
docs.text:
表 编号 事件 ID 有效负载跟踪列 store_consumed_event 大智 VARCHAR(36) 独特 aggregate_id、payload_hash(64) inventory_consumed_event 大智 VARCHAR(36) 独特 aggregate_id、payload_hash(64) settlement_consumed_event INT VARCHAR(64) 独特 source_aggregate_type、source_aggregate_id、payload_hash(64)

所有三个共享 topic、processed_at 和 payload_hash（JSON 编码的 SHA-256） 信封）。 Trade 没有收件箱表：它的处理程序由工作流程的保护 can(transition) 检查加上事务内的 store-uuid 快照匹配，因此 重复的 store.order.accepted.v1 / store.order.rejected.v1 是无操作。

docs.title: 4.2 eventId 的幂等性
docs.text:
规范的消费者形状 - 读取检查，然后在交易内重新检查，以及 以原子方式写入消耗的行，效果如下：

public function __invoke(TradeOrderCreatedMessage $message): void
{
    $eventId = $message->envelope['eventId'] ?? null;
    $payload = $message->envelope['payload'] ?? null;
    // ...validate...

    if ($this->consumedEventRepository->findOneBy(['eventId' => $eventId]) !== null) {
        return; // already processed
    }

    $this->entityManager->wrapInTransaction(function () use ($eventId, ...): void {
        if ($this->consumedEventRepository->findOneBy(['eventId' => $eventId]) !== null) {
            return; // re-check under the transaction (closes the race window)
        }
        $this->entityManager->persist(new StoreConsumedEvent(
            $eventId,
            'trade.order.created.v1',
            (string) ($payload['orderUuid'] ?? ''),
            hash('sha256', json_encode($message->envelope, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),
        ));
        // ...apply the business effect...
    });
}

库存进一步收紧。它的isAlreadyConsumed()比较存储的 payload_hash 以及使用 hash_equals 到达的信封的哈希值；一个重复使用的 eventId 具有 不同 有效负载会引发 InventoryMessageIntegrityException （“事件 ID 已与不同的有效负载一起重复使用”）。结算的exists($eventId)支票是 更简单：重复使用的 id 会被默默地跳过。

docs.title: 4.3 验证
docs.text:
处理程序在接触数据库之前会防御性地验证其信封：

  • type / version 完全匹配（例如 'inventory.reservation.released' / 1）。
  • 必需的键存在于正确的标量类型中（eventId 是 商店管理员；库存处理程序还要求它是格式正确的 UUID）。
  • 库存另外验证：aggregateId === payload['reservationId']， 每个 id 的 UUID 格式 ^[0-9a-f]{8}-…-[1-8]…-[89ab]…$，ISO-8601 时间戳 （允许使用小数秒）、唯一的线路 ID 和数量字符串匹配 ^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,6})?$。
  • 相关性交叉检查（例如ReservationReleaseRequestedHandler验证 信封中的 storeUuid / tradeOrderUuid / storeOrderUuid 与存储的匹配 保留，否则会抛出InventoryMessageIntegrityException）。
  • 使重试无害的业务防护：仅限ReservationConfirmedHandler 接受仍为 awaiting_inventory 且其 reservationId == payload['reservationId']； SettlementService::postAllocation() 对于已经 posted / cancelled / reversed 分配提前返回。

docs.title: 5. 相关性/因果关系追踪
docs.text:
• 交易 分配 correlationId = aggregateId （交易订单 uuid）和 causationId = null 在每个出站信封上 — 整个订单传奇（订单创建 → 店铺受理→库存预约→取消）共享该关联范围。
  • 结算 是唯一将跟踪保存到其域模型中的模块： SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage 带有 correlationId/causationId，并且 settlement_plan 存储 correlation_id 和 causation_id 列。的 SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler 将它们复制到 SettlementFunding 合约中。
  • 商店/库存信封不带有相关性/因果关系标头；血统是 根据有效负载相关键重建 - orderUuid、storeUuid、 tradeOrderUuid、storeOrderUuid、reservationId — 以及来自消费事件 aggregate_id 列。

docs.title: 6.1 贸易订单→商店→库存预订
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant T as Trade
    participant TO as Trade Outbox
    participant S as Store
    participant SO as Store Outbox
    participant I as Inventory
    participant IO as Inventory Outbox

    T->>T: OrderService::createOrder()<br/>(txn) workflow store_submit
    T->>TO: (txn) += trade.order.created.v1
    TO->>S: app:trade:outbox:publish → TradeOrderCreatedMessage
    S->>S: (txn) inbox += trade.order.created.v1
    alt store inactive
        S->>SO: (txn) += store.order.rejected.v1 (STORE_UNAVAILABLE)
    else INVENTORY_ENABLED=0
        S->>S: accept immediately
    else reserve
        S->>SO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.requested.v1
        SO->>I: app:store:outbox:publish → ReservationRequestedMessage
        I->>I: (txn) inbox += requested; InventoryService::reserve()
        alt shortfall
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.rejected.v1
        else success
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1
        end
        IO->>S: app:inventory:outbox:publish → ReservationConfirmed/Rejected
        S->>S: (txn) inbox += outcome; accept/reject storeOrder
        S->>SO: (txn) += store.order.rejected.v1 (if rejected)
        SO->>T: app:store:outbox:publish → StoreOrderRejectedMessage
        T->>T: workflow store_reject / store_accept
    end

docs.title: 6.2 订单取消→商店→库存释放
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant T as Trade
    participant TO as Trade Outbox
    participant S as Store
    participant SO as Store Outbox
    participant I as Inventory
    participant IO as Inventory Outbox

    T->>T: OrderWorkflowListener (transition 'cancel')
    alt order has store metadata
        T->>TO: (txn) += trade.order.cancelled.v1
        TO->>S: app:trade:outbox:publish → TradeOrderCancelledMessage
        S->>S: (txn) inbox += trade.order.cancelled.v1
        alt store order exists
            S->>S: cancel it
            S->>SO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.release.requested.v1
            SO->>I: app:store:outbox:publish → ReservationReleaseRequestedMessage
            I->>I: (txn) inbox += release.requested; InventoryService::release()
            I->>IO: (txn) += inventory.reservation.released.v1
            IO->>S: app:inventory:outbox:publish → ReservationReleasedMessage
            S->>S: inbox dedup only
        else store order missing
            S->>S: persist StoreTradeOrderCancellation (applied later)
        end
    end

docs.title: 6.3 过期预订
docs.text: app:inventory:reservations:release-expired → InventoryService::releaseExpiredReservations() 查找过去的 confirmed 预订 expires_at 并以原因 reservation expired 释放它们，从而重新进入 上面的标准 inventory.reservation.released.v1 发件箱流程。

docs.title: 6.4 结算分配过账
docs.text:
结算是一个收件箱优先模块：资金确认从外部到达 显式字段消息。

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant P as External producer
    participant H as SettlementFundingConfirmedHandler
    participant S as SettlementService
    participant SO as Settlement Outbox
    participant A as SettlementAllocationPostingHandler
    participant V as Wallet voucher port

    P->>H: SettlementFundingConfirmedMessage (async)
    H->>H: dedup exists(eventId)
    H->>S: (txn) createPlanFromFunding()
    S->>S: build SettlementPlan + SettlementAllocation rows
    S->>SO: (txn) += settlement.allocation.post.requested.v1 (per allocation)
    H->>H: (txn) persist SettlementConsumedEvent
    SO->>A: app:settlement:outbox:publish → SettlementAllocationPostingMessage
    A->>A: mark posting_requested (flush first)
    A->>V: voucherPort->post() (posting_idempotency_key)
    alt success
        V-->>A: markPosted(reference)
    else retryable
        V-->>A: markRetryableFailure (next +60s)
    else fatal
        V-->>A: markFailed
    end
    A->>A: reconcilePlanState()
    Note over SO: app:settlement:allocations:requeue-due<br/>re-queues retryable_failure rows

结算重试循环使用的状态：分配planned → posting_requested → posted（终端cancelled/failed/reversed/reversal_pending）， retryable_failure喂养requeue-due。在测试装置中，凭证边界是 InMemorySettlementVoucherPort。

docs.title: 7. 操作注意事项
docs.text:
• 死信在failed传输上累积（messenger_messages与 queue_name = 'failed');发件箱行未发布，因此可以手动 重新排队或修复。
  • 卡住的行显示为带有非空 last_error 的 published_at IS NULL；他们是 在 available_at 通过后自动重新尝试。
  • 比赛安全依赖于有条件的索赔更新（published_at IS NULL AND available_at <= now），加上每个发件箱上的索引(published_at, available_at) 表（库存附加id）。
  • INVENTORY_ENABLED环境切换决定商店是否跳过库存 完全并立即接受订单，或等待 inventory.reservation.confirmed.v1。

docs.title: Project Structure
docs.text: Map of the repository and the conventions that keep it consistent. See Architecture for the rules that shape this layout.

docs.title: Top-level view
docs.text:
crud-skeleton/
├── src/                    # All application code (PSR-4 namespace App\)
├── config/                 # Symfony + module routing & service configuration
├── migrations/             # Doctrine versioned migrations (DoctrineMigrations\)
├── tests/                  # PHPUnit tests, grouped by execution tier
├── docs/                   # Documentation site (MkDocs) + archives
├── scripts/                # Build, translation, and smoke/stress tooling
├── public/                 # Web root (index.php, assets)
├── var/                    # Cache, logs, JWT keys, test DBs (git-ignored)
├── translations/           # Symfony translation catalogues
├── templates/              # Twig templates (dev/profiler pages)
├── assets/                 # Asset-map sources (js/css imports)
├── docker/                 # Container files: entrypoint.sh, nginx config
├── compose.yaml            # Base service stack
├── compose.override.yaml   # Development overlay (dev flags, source bind, ports)
├── compose.prod.yaml       # Production overlay
├── Dockerfile              # PHP-FPM image for app/worker/scheduler
├── mkdocs.yml              # Docs site navigation (English)
├── mkdocs-en.yml / mkdocs-zh.yml   # Bilingual docs builds
├── phpunit.dist.xml        # PHPUnit configuration
├── phpstan.neon            # Static analysis configuration (Level 8)
├── rector.php / rector-types.php   # Rector rulesets
└── .env*                   # Environment files (.env, .env.example, .env.test, ...)

docs.title: src/ — application modules
docs.text:
Each business module is a vertical slice. Core is the framework layer; all other modules plug into it.

src/
├── Kernel.php                      # Application kernel (no App\Kernel, lives in src/)
├── Core/                           # Framework core — depends on nothing business
│   ├── CoreBundle.php              # Bundle class registered in config/bundles.php
│   ├── Controller/
│   │   ├── RestController.php      # Base REST controller (success/warning, pagination)
│   │   ├── DefaultController.php, HealthController.php, MetricsController.php
│   │   └── System/                 # /system/* introspection (Entity, Router)
│   ├── View/                       # API view mixins (List/Detail/Create/Update/Delete/…)
│   ├── Service/
│   │   ├── BaseService.php         # Generic CRUD service base + ServiceLocator glue
│   │   ├── BaseServiceInterface.php
│   │   ├── Concern/                # Infrastructure / ReadList / Mutation traits
│   │   ├── ExpressionService.php   # @filter/@sort/@dql/@order/@select engine
│   │   └── QueryBuilderFactory.php, DefaultServiceLocator.php
│   ├── Parser/                     # ExpressionDqlParser, ExpressionQueryBuilderAssembler

│

│   ├── Controller/Public/MediaController.php
│   ├── Entity/                     # Category, Tag, Content, Comment, Page, Media, Picture, Setting
│   ├── Repository/                 # …Repository.php + …RepositoryInterface.php
│   └── Service/                    # …Service.php + …ServiceInterface.php per entity
│
├── Identity/                       # Auth & accounts
│   ├── Command/CreateUserCommand.php        # app:identity:user:create
│   ├── Controller/{Auth, Otp}.php, Controller/{App,Manage}/…

│   ├── Entity/                     # Store, Membership, StoreOrder, StoreOutboxMessage, …
